---
title: Compact report
author: Test Author
subtitle: A subtitle long enough to run beside the corner motif and wrap onto a second line of text
abstract: |
  This abstract opens page 1.

  A second abstract paragraph that is long enough to reach the right margin of the page if nothing narrows it, so the check sees any text under the corner motif.
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
    type: report
    layout: compact
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The compact report of the gold preset starts on page 1 with the title block, the abstract and the body.
        check: bash _checks/types.sh compact gold
    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['mcanouil-document\(\s*"report",\s*"compact",\s*none']
---

{{< include _compact.qmd >}}
